description: This file contains implementations of Orleans grain classes related to request context testing, including methods for tracing and logging request IDs and activity IDs, as well as handling asynchronous context propagation.

classes.name: RequestContextTestGrain
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve and echo the 'TraceId' from RequestContext, including delayed and recursive calls.

classes.name: RequestContextTaskGrain
classes.description: Implements request ID tracing with detailed logging, demonstrating propagation across asynchronous calls, including various ways to handle continuations and delays.

classes.name: RequestContextProxyGrain
classes.description: A simple proxy class that delegates E2E activity ID retrieval to another grain.

methods.name: TraceIdDoubleEcho
methods.description: Calls another grain to echo the 'TraceId'.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEcho1
methods.description: Returns the 'TraceId' inside a new task started with Task.Factory.StartNew.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEcho2
methods.description: Returns the 'TraceId' asynchronously after a completed task.

methods.name: E2EActivityId
methods.description: Returns the current ReentrancyId from RequestContext.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEchoAwait
methods.description: Returns the 'TraceId' inside an awaited continuation.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEchoTaskRun
methods.description: Returns the 'TraceId' via Task.Run to demonstrate context flow.

methods.name: TestRequestContext
methods.description: Sets a value in RequestContext and retrieves it from different asynchronous tasks, verifying context propagation.

methods.name: E2EActivityId
methods.description: Delegates activity ID retrieval to another grain.
